name: Relaxing games
intro: Slow down with calm games that never rush you. Sort colors, grow a garden or build a cozy cafe at your own pace.

name: Games for two players
short: Share one screen with a friend
intro: Grab a friend and share one keyboard or one phone. These games are quick to learn and end in a few minutes, so rematches are easy.

name: One tap games
short: Easy to learn, hard to put down
intro: Every game here uses a single tap or click. Perfect for playing with one hand on your phone.

name: Halloween games
intro: Pumpkins, ghosts and haunted houses. Spooky games that are more fun than scary.

name: Best on mobile
intro: Games that feel great on a touch screen. Tap, swipe and play in your phone browser.

name: Skill challenges
intro: Fast reactions and good timing win here. Try to beat your own best run.
